concerns.text: Constitution Principle VII mandates that model performance be evaluated against a MAE < 0.4 eV threshold. The plan’s Phase 8 lists many evaluation steps (MAE, RMSE, R², baseline comparison, OOD flagging, etc.) but does not explicitly enforce or report a pass/fail condition based on the 0.4 eV MAE ceiling, nor does it tie this check to a success criterion. This omission means the plan could produce results that violate the scaffold‑based generalization principle without being flagged.
